rules.statement: Section 349 of the Ceylon Civil Procedure Code applies only to decrees for the payment of money and not to other types of decrees such as those requiring the execution of a settlement.
rules.supporting_quote: "Their Lordships are conscious that the latter of these difficulties might be avoided by attaching a somewhat artificial meaning to the words 'adjustment' and 'adjusted'. If the Court is at liberty to recognize anything done by the judgment-debtor in conformity with the decree (other than a payment), the effect of any partial compliance with it would have to be considered before executing the decree."
